assumptions: HCR v3.0's 52 nt window and split geometry; RNA:DNA free energies from the stated model.
limits: Genome uniqueness is only checked when a bowtie2 alignment of the tiles is given.
Designs pairs; amplifier kinetics and signal are not modelled.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which HCR v3.0 split-initiator probe pairs tile this target within their composition and free-energy windows?

description: Design HCR v3.0 split-initiator probe pairs against the subject: tile its reverse complement into 52 nt windows, drop windows with C or G runs, a stable hairpin, G+C or RNA:DNA free energy outside their windows, or (given a bowtie2 alignment of the tiles) more than one genome hit, then pick non-overlapping tiles closest to the target free energy and split each around a 2 nt gap into an odd and an even probe carrying half of the chosen amplifier's initiator. Each stage reports how many tiles it kept.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alignment_sam.description: SAM from bowtie2 -k 3 -f of the tiles FASTA this tool returns, against your genome or transcriptome. Without it no tile is checked for uniqueness and the result says so.

channel.description: HCR amplifier whose split initiator the pair carries; one channel per target in a multiplexed experiment.

dtm_filter.description: also require the two halves' melting temperatures to agree. Advanced.

dtm_max.description: largest allowed difference between the halves' melting temperatures. In °C. Only applies when dtm_filter is true. Advanced.

max_gc.description: highest percent G+C of a tile. In %.

max_gibbs.description: least stable RNA:DNA free energy to accept. In kcal/mol.

max_hairpin_tm.description: drop a tile whose primer3 hairpin melts at or above this. In °C. Advanced.

max_run_length.description: window length for the C and G run check. In nt. Advanced.

max_run_mismatches.description: bases in that window allowed to differ from the run base. In nt. Advanced.

min_gc.description: lowest percent G+C of a tile. In %.

min_gibbs.description: most stable RNA:DNA free energy to accept (at 37 °C, 0.33 M Na⁺). In kcal/mol.

num_hits_allowed.description: most alignments a tile may have and still be kept (its own locus counts as one). Only applies when alignment_sam is set.

target_gibbs.description: free energy the selection ranks tiles by closeness to. In kcal/mol.

tile_size.description: length of the target window each pair covers, both halves and the 2 nt gap. In nt. Advanced.

name: design_hcr_probes

explanation.description: the derivation chain: conclusion, interpretation and machinery, generated from this run

orderTable.description: every odd then every even oligo as a Name/Sequence table for plate ordering

pairCount.description: how many probe pairs were selected

pairs.description: the selected probe pairs, ranked by closeness to the target free energy, each with both oligos, its 1-based start, G+C, Tm, half-Tm difference, free energy and genome hits

stages.description: how many tiles each stage kept, in pipeline order

tilesFasta.description: the tiles that pass the run and hairpin checks, as FASTA, for bowtie2 -k 3 -f
